name: orbit-devops
description: AI-native GitLab DevOps system with multi-agent orchestration

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && echo "Staging build artifacts prepared. Configure your GitLab/Vercel deploy target to publish them."
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && echo "Production build artifacts prepared. Configure your GitLab/Vercel deploy target to publish them."
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend

author: Orbit DevOps Team
